topic: Definition of authorized person, QM & QS – scope area of responsibilities, and its awarding / removal / restoration/ recording, QS/QM
syllabus_extract: Definition of authorized person, QM & QS – scope area of responsibilities, and its awarding / removal / restoration/ recording, QS/QM.
specific_objectives: 1.1.1.2 Trainee will be able to understand the qualification of responsibilities and promotion regulations.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of QM/QS qualification records and verification of scope of responsibility against authorized person definitions.
intro_questions: What is the definition of an authorized person in aircraft maintenance?
Can a trainee perform maintenance without QM or QS qualification?
What is the primary difference between QM and QS responsibilities?

development.content:
Definition of authorized person
Scope of QM responsibilities
Scope of QS responsibilities
Qualification awarding process
Removal and restoration procedures

Recording of QM/QS status
Promotion regulations for QM/QS
Verification of scope area
Documentation requirements
Role of supervisory checks

Independent check procedures
Flight safety implications
Restoration of authority
Record keeping standards
Compliance with regulations

summary_questions: Explain the process for awarding QM or QS qualification.
Describe the steps required to restore QM/QS authority after removal.
How does the scope of responsibility differ between QM and QS?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the promotion regulations for QM and QS and how they relate to the scope of responsibilities covered in LP 02.

pft_rows.syllabus: Supervisory status, FSI, Senior Maintenance Rating – scope area of responsibilities w.r.t supervisory checks, independent check and flight servicing.
